title: Mike Israetel's DANGEROUS steroid advice
summary: A response to Mike Israetel's video recommending oral-only first cycles. NH argues that so-called PED prevention content works as promotion and that no PED use is responsible. He also argues that orals lower the barrier to entry more than injectables do, because their quick benefits and hidden side effects ease people into addiction.
claims: He respects Israetel's programming and nutrition advice; the criticism is only about PED advice
A PED user is biased by his enhanced identity, so his PED advice cannot be neutral
Opening a video with 'don't do drugs' and then listing benefits works as promotion; young viewers remember only the benefits
The '10 years natural before PEDs' rule is arbitrary, lets speakers dodge responsibility, and almost nobody truly trains 10 serious natural years
If only a tiny fraction of an audience that is 99% natural will use PEDs, PED harm-reduction videos mostly recruit new users
The honesty era about steroid use made PED use mainstream; teenagers now joke about tren
Making a drug easier to access increases use; he compares it to drug legalisation and cocaine availability rising since the 80s
There is no responsible steroid use; it is like playing Russian roulette carefully
Steroids are both psychologically and physiologically addictive, like hard drugs
He himself spent hours listening to tren and deca talk as a young lifter and was being lured in
Joking in PED prevention content lightens a serious topic and turns it into entertainment and promotion
Dipping a toe in PEDs is the start of addiction; there is no such thing as one cycle
Orals work like a boiling frog: benefits kick in within about two days while side effects accumulate unnoticed
A bad first PED experience (needles, delayed injectable results around week 4) would scare more people off than a pleasant oral cycle
SARMs spread among teens because drops and pills are easy and not scary; they then progress to orals and injections
Black-market orals come unlabeled and teens will overdose to reach goals faster
Lab tests of seized 'Anavar' in the US usually find Dianabol, which is more liver-toxic and androgenic
Oral-only cycles still suppress testosterone, especially when the compound is not what was claimed or the dose is exceeded
Students at his university gym ran oral-only cycles without PCT, grew a lot, then lost everything and had tendon pain for months
Gains made with a drug leave when the drug leaves; otherwise people would not blast and cruise
Women taking PEDs, even supposed Anavar, risk permanent virilisation; anyone advising women to use PEDs is harming them
Coming off PEDs drops you below your baseline, which pushes users back onto drugs, as with painkillers
Good bloodwork does not rule out heart damage or hormone damage
Health advice from someone using hard drugs daily is tainted by cognitive dissonance
Naturals binge-watching PED content are warming themselves up to use
Prevention should return to a strict 'just don't do steroids' message
Natural lifting is the optimal path for health, longevity and well-being
